title: Leaf miner on snow peas - Kenya

Header: Leaf miner on snow peas - Kenya

Prevention: Rotate with non-host plants such as maize, sorghum or millet.
Do not plant a new crop next to a previously infected crop.
Conserve natural enemies by planting flower hedge rows and through minimizing use of broad spectrum insecticides.
Apply balanced crop nutrition, without overuse of nitrogen.
Monitoring: Examine the foliage for signs of tunnelling or mining.
Use yellow sticky traps (one per acre) to monitor for adults.
Consider action if 5-10% of leaves are infested.
Direct Control: Use yellow sticky traps to attract and kill adult leaf miners.
Drench soil with imidacloprid based products
Restrictions: Wear appropriate personal protective equipment when using pesticides.
Follow instructions on the product label (dosage, application timing, PHI, number of sprays, REI).
Toxic to bees, avoid application on the flowering crop.
